captured: staging, 2026-10-10, the #295 rehearsal: scripts/ecs_rolling_rollout.sh rolled experimentation-dashboard-staging out to a revision whose image digest does not exist, and ECS's deployment circuit breaker rolled it back
about: What the script was given and what it printed. `reads` are describe-services of the service, read about every 15 s by a loop beside the script (not the script's own reads, which were not recorded): numbered from the read before the update-service call (1), trimmed to the fields the script reads, and a run of reads identical in those fields kept once (`reads` names the run). Only the read the script decided on keeps its events, the first 10, which is all the script prints; it printed exactly these. Reads 51 onward repeat read 50 in these fields and are left out. The account is replaced by 123456789012 inside each ARN and the ECR registry host; nothing else is changed.
